newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Oct natgas prices edge up on storage - NGC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Oct natgas prices edge up on storage - NGC.

text.p: U.S. spot natural gas prices for October edged up slightly from September, driven by increases in production area storage injections, Natural Gas Clearinghouse (NGC) said Monday.
U.S. spot gas prices for October averaged $1.73 per million British thermal units, up five cents on the month and 20 cents over last year's average.

Prices into Columbia Gas rose five cents on the month to $1.80 and also held a 20-cent premium to last year, NGC said in its monthly survey. Most Gulf pipes gained about five cents for the month and remained 15-25 cents above year-ago.
Oklahoma prices were unchanged to five cents higher for the month, with sales into ANR in Custer County, Okla., averaging $1.70, 20 cents above last year's levels.
Prices for Texas Eastern in Texas were steady from September at about $1.70 but were still 15 cents above year-ago.
